paper_topology: the paper gives the surfaces and the topology graph of phi(s,t) = 0 in Q's domain (Fig. 14) with helping points; it states no topology in words
matched: the exact P(u,v) (homogeneous weight 2) and Q(s,t) as published, on [0,1]^2 and [-1,1]x[0,2] (Q stored remapped to [0,1]^2)
guessed: nothing about the geometry; ground truth is our own numerical continuation in (u,v,s,t) (param_trace.py), points on both surfaces to ~1e-15; P overlaps itself, so pieces may meet in 3D on different sheets of P. The NURBS form of Q is the paper's Q(s,t) remapped onto [0,1]^2 (s' = (s+1)/2, t' = t/2), so SMLib's parameter values (and any comparison with Fig. 14's helping points) differ from the paper's (s,t)
